task: e_x0_pocs — receipt the seed charter 8 granular POC claims against exoj/core.mjs (JS port)
rng: mulberry32, fixed seeds, no Math.random, no network
note: decision rules follow in poc_rules rows BEFORE any result row

rules.p1_conservation: PASS iff after ≥10 balanced soft writes (γ+η=1 per emit) across ≥4 loci on a seed-policy field: |Σ − 1.0| ≤ 1e-9 AND max_cell_Σ ≤ 1 + 1e-9
rules.p2_creative_band: PASS iff computed zone fraction (active cells with 0.4 ≤ Δ ≤ 0.6) equals 4/6 within 1e-6 when 4 of 6 touched cells are emitted in-band and 2 emitted far out-of-band (Δ_write 0.10 and 0.90 — note: the cell prior Δ=0.5 pulls one-shot α=0.4 writes toward band, so 0.30/0.72 would stay in-band; receipted port semantics) (seed claims 0.667)
rules.p3_local_collapse: PASS iff after observe(0,0): attended cell prob_mass == 0 AND hex-neighbour (1,0) prob_mass ≥ 0.999 AND distant cell (0,3) prob_mass ≥ 0.999 (no global collapse)
rules.p4_multi_observer: PASS iff attend(alpha,beta,gamma) leaves all three registered, and Σ/prob_open identical before vs after attends to 1e-15 (attending deforms nothing)
rules.p5_soft_vectors: PASS iff all 100 emissions (4 backends x 25) satisfy Δ ∈ [0.4, 0.6] (inclusive, 1e-12 tol) AND |γ+η − 1| ≤ 1e-9, read from the chained event payloads
rules.p6_projection: PASS iff project(auditor) returns format exoj-projection-v1 with sense + ≤12 recent deformations + observation history, appends ZERO chain rows (observer pre-registered) and leaves Σ/prob_open unchanged to 1e-15
rules.p7_programs: PASS iff every-program (period 3) fires exactly at t ∈ {3,6,9} by t=10 and at-program fires exactly once at t=5, both receipted as chained deform rows tagged program:<id>
rules.p8_chain: PASS iff verifyChain ok on the mixed session field (deforms+observe+attach+tick+refuse) AND the chain re-verifies from the SAVED file after ExoJ.load
